tools.name: ccvshop_list_products
tools.description: List the products of this webshop, filtered by product number, EAN or a part of the name. Returns items with ids, prices and stock. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/products/.

tools.name: ccvshop_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id, with its prices, stock, description and attributes. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/products/{id}/.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_orders
tools.description: List orders of this webshop. Filter by order number, status, paid state or a creation date range (yyyy-mm-dd). Use this to find recent sales. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/orders/.

tools.name: ccvshop_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id: customer, totals, payment and delivery data. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/orders/{id}/.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_order_rows
tools.description: List the order lines (products, quantities, prices) of one order. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/orders/{id}/orderrows/.

tools.name: ccvshop_add_order_note
tools.description: Add an INTERNAL note to one order. The note is not emailed to the customer and does not change the order. Uses POST /api/rest/v1/orders/{id}/ordernotes/.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_categories
tools.description: List the product categories of this webshop. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/categories/.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_brands
tools.description: List the brands of this webshop. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/brands/.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers of this webshop. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/suppliers/.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of this webshop. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/invoices/.

tools.name: ccvshop_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/invoices/{id}/.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_users
tools.description: List the customer accounts (users) of this webshop, optionally by approval status (pending or accepted). Uses GET /api/rest/v1/users/.

tools.name: ccvshop_get_user
tools.description: Get one customer account (user) by id. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/users/{id}/.
